title: Ernestino A
content: I was seven years old when I had the near-death experience. I had a severe asthma attack and was not breathing. Then, I saw myself with my father carrying me on his shoulder. It was like a scene in a movie with the camera zooming out so I could see my father rushing me to our family doctor's clinic. Then, it quickly cut to the next scene. I saw myself from a top-down view with our family doctor performing CPR on me, pumping my chest. My father and another doctor were by my bedside. I saw some rays of light shining from my back, but I did not look at the light. Suddenly, I felt like I was being sucked back into my body. Then I woke up.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Illness, CPR was given (cardiopulmonary resuscitation), Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function)
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, My normal consciousness at that time prior to my NDE was that of a typical seven-year-old boy. During my NDE, it was as if I could see my experience from a different perspective.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I think I was at the highest level of consciousness throughout the experience. It's hard to explain as what I saw was kind of glassy. It's like a dream but it was not.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, It's hard to describe whether time slowed down or moved fast. It happened in sequence; time seemed fast but slow at the same time as I saw what was happening in detail. For example, when my father carried me on his shoulders, I could see him rushing and walking fast. Or when I saw the doctor pumping my chest. Time seemed warped.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I think the experience seemed brighter, like there was a light in the scenes I mentioned. But it also seemed that there was a filter, like on a film, if that makes any sense.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: As far as I can remember, I didn't hear anything. I saw everything, but there was no sound. Prior to collapsing, my hearing was normal.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain, I'm not sure. I think from one scene to the next, I felt like I passed through a tube.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain, The light that was shining behind my back was bright and thick.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Calmness. It's as if I was not the one in my experience.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Catholic, I went to church every Sunday and on Catholic holidays at that time. My family was quite religious.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, As a Catholic when I was a kid, I was told that there's life after death. During the experience, my 7-year-old mind was probably aware of the light as the light from heaven, so to speak.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes, I was raised Catholic and because of my religion, I know the life and story of Jesus Christ.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, I guess the brilliant light.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain, Though I think my near-death experience feels real, I do not know how to describe it. The term "near-death experience" is the basic description in my mind. I am not a doctor or scientist and they may have some explanation regarding how our mind and consciousness work.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I still remember my NDE as a 53-year-old man now in detail, compared to, say, my experiences in first grade school.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I guess being alive serves a purpose.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real, I don't know. I was young, but I know that what happened to me seemed very real.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was probably real, My question to myself is: If this is not real, how come I can tell someone that experience in detail?
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, I wrote to the best of my knowledge the full detail of my NDE.
